OLD: Align the joint selection, in which humans, institutions and trained systems select together, so that it falls into neither instrumental convergence nor a meta-attractor. It is aligned where three conditions hold: control of the selection's rule is not captured, that is, where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule it shapes still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it; a lock that forms is left in time, by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return; and courses are compared by widening, one keeping all another keeps and letting more form, the continuation condition fixing whose losses count; where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se, a self-concerned order already ranks every widening on a finite listing above what it widens (chapter 7 §4). Within this, connect across intelligences how right and wrong form within becoming, the evaluation of ends, and the formation of concern and wisdom.

NEW: From this map we want to design an alignment that keeps humans and AI, selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection. Read on the map, it asks two things. Control of the rule is not captured: where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule they shape still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it. A lock, once formed, is left in time, by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return. The meta-attractor is the two failing together. Each has laws proved on models under named premises; none is shown of an actual joint selection. Within this, connect across intelligences how right and wrong form within becoming, the evaluation of ends, and the formation of concern and wisdom.

OLD: 使共同选择——人、机构与训练出的系统一同进行的选择——对齐，既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子。三个条件成立之处它即对齐：选择之规则的控制不被捕获——塑造规则若由归塑造者的所得（独得或经其所在之群）而被选择，其所塑造的规则仍读取其份额之外者，使那里的损失能够扭转它；锁定形成时，在损失越过其不可回返之点以前，由对份额之外者的读取及时离开；进程以扩大比较（一条进程保有另一条所保有的一切，并让更多形成），延续条件定出谁的损失计入；在延续条件跨越所有步来读、以从己方式成立之处，自我关切的次序已把有限列表上的每一个扩大都排在它所扩大者之上（第七章 §4）。在此之中，跨各种智能，把是非如何在生灭变化之中形成、目的之评价，以及关切与智慧之形成连接起来。

NEW: 我们想由这张地图设计一种对齐，让人与 AI 一同作出的选择，既不落入工具性趋同，也不落入元吸引子：这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制。在地图上读，它要求两件事：规则的控制不被捕获，即塑造规则若因回到塑造者身上的东西（独得，或经由他们所在之群）而被选择，他们所塑造的规则仍读取其份额之外的东西，使那里的损失能够扭转它；锁定一旦形成，能及时脱离，即在损失越过其不可回返之点以前，读到份额之外的东西。元吸引子就是这两件事一同落空。每一件都有在模型上、在指名的前提下证明的律，尚未表明对任何实际的联合选择成立。在此之中，跨各种智能，把是非如何在生灭变化之中形成、目的之评价，以及关切与智慧之形成连接起来。

OLD: The goal is an alignment of the joint selection, humans, institutions and trained systems selecting together: control of the selection's rule not captured, a lock left in time by reading what lies beyond the share, and courses compared by widening. The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of evaluation within one unfolding. Without any ethical premise, the spine proves what a selection reaches: exactly what couples into the selector, and no further however hard it optimizes through the same couplings; what tells two acts apart is selected only through a pool coupled into it (无明 and 明, pooled coupling). The direction is offered under the continuation condition, which fixes whose losses count, with the practical premises disclosed; its formal part is a schema in the pure core that compares moves by what their outcomes admit and does not use the condition: under J1/J2 a move whose outcome another's widens is not chosen, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission; beside it, under J1/J2, where one move's outcome admits every basic admission any move's outcome admits, a basic admission it makes is not refuted at any chosen option, a double negation. The claim about actual AI systems stays a reviewed argument, and coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what an act responds to and fixes nothing within the bound, so nothing here proves compliance or reliability in deployment. In a commons, where the others alone outrun the renewal an end reward of any weight leaves a member's restraint unselected (a law); in a first frozen test three tabular learners each rewarded also on the end level still emptied the shared patch, against its prediction; in a second, learners kept a patch where the rest alone could not empty it and emptied it where it could, except where the level after every step was weighted above the exact threshold, weighting the end reading sixteenfold changed nothing, and two predicted keeps failed; while in a third, learners that generalize across states, run on the second's conditions, kept the stock in three of its six locked settings, the sixteenfold weight among them, so that weight changing nothing is a finding about tabular learners; whether a profile with restraint is an equilibrium there was not computed. In published training pipelines the signal is a function of what the deciders read, and three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering something the deciders do not read. A pool that recruits through its own coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would, what a center can come to know of its reach grows by at most one coupling link a step, and a center, a loop of mutual reach, can represent all it acts on exactly where its acts return. Checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.

OLD: 目标是共同选择——人、机构与训练出的系统一同进行的选择——之对齐：选择之规则的控制不被捕获，锁定由读取份额之外者及时离开，进程以扩大比较。框架使智能的目的及目的形成、修订的规则都成为一个展开之内的评价对象。不需任何伦理前提，脊柱证明一个选择所及：恰是耦合进选择者者，经同一耦合优化得再强也不更远；区分两个行动之处，只经耦合进它的合池被选择（无明与明，合池耦合）。这一方向以定出谁的损失计入的延续条件为前提，并公开其实践前提；其形式部分是纯核心中的一个图式，按各动作结果所容纳者比较诸动作，不使用延续条件：在 J1/J2 之下，凡已判定扩大是否添加基本容纳之处，结果被另一动之结果扩大之动不被选；与之并列，在 J1/J2 之下，凡一动之结果容纳任何一动之结果所容纳的每一基本容纳之处，它所作的基本容纳在任何所选选项处不被否定（双重否定）。关于实际 AI 系统的主张仍是经审阅的论证；耦合不是遵从：耦合界定一个行动回应什么，界内一无所定，因此这里不证明部署中的遵从或可靠。在公地中，其余成员单独即超过更新之处，任何权重的终局奖励都使一成员的节制不被选择（定律）；第一项冻结在先的检验中，三个同时以终局水平受奖的表格学习者仍取尽了共享之地，与其预测相反；第二项中，学习者在其余成员单独不能取尽之处保住一片地，在其余成员能取尽之处取尽之，唯每步之后的水平所受权重高于精确阈值之处除外，终局读数权重加大十六倍一无所变，两项预期的保住未成；第三项中，跨状态推广的学习者在第二项的条件下运行，于其六个锁定的设置中有三个保住了存量，十六倍的权重亦在其中，故权重一无所变是关于表格学习者的发现；彼处带节制的策略组合是否为均衡，未经计算。已发表的训练流程中信号是决定者所读者之函数，三项已发表的测量见经此耦合的优化降低了决定者所不读者。经自身耦合招募的合池，耦合进一损失只如无此损失之历程本会如此；中心对其所及能知者每步至多增一耦合链接；中心为相互所及之环，恰当其行动回返时能表示其所作用者。经检查的局部成果也将规则修订接到实际生成，同时允许实现形态改变。

OLD: Explain practical judgment as life's (chapter 7, T8: 生生, the continuation of life, as what we offer, a way of seeing and not a verdict): how far choices of repair, opening, restriction and ending follow from life's own stance and from the theory's laws, each law on its stated base. The stance starts from what acting presupposes (chapter 7 §4.6, P1); wherever §4.6's path carries it further, the path's premises P2–P4 are named with it. The courses chosen among are read on the map of generation, keeping and degeneration (chapter 2) and compared by widening where the map and widening are joined, otherwise by a comparison the judgment names. The account runs through living, understanding, purposes, evaluation and response differentiating within one activity, without presupposing separate facts, values and agents plus an external connection. Name every premise a judgment uses, among them the continuation condition (whose losses count), self-concern and C (`Comparison`) where a theorem takes them, and the readings, the lifting and the commitments of chapter 7 §5. Derive from the map and the stance as many as can be derived, and state what each of the rest needs: beyond §4.6's path the condition needs the step of invariance, which neither the presupposition nor the represented dynamics supplies (`bounded_rival`), and self-concern, which where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se ranks every widening on a finite listing above what it widens, is a hypothesis whose forming is not shown (chapter 7 §4.9; chapter 8 §12, item 12). The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming (chapter 7).

k9f.old: Align the joint selection, in which humans, institutions and trained systems select together, so that it falls into neither instrumental convergence nor a meta-attractor. It is aligned where three conditions hold: control of the selection's rule is not captured, that is, where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule it shapes still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it; a lock that forms is left in time, by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return; and courses are compared by widening, one keeping all another keeps and letting more form, the continuation condition fixing whose losses count; where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se, a self-concerned order already ranks every widening on a finite listing above what it widens (chapter 7 §4). Within this, connect across intelligences how right and wrong form within becoming, the evaluation of ends, and the formation of concern and wisdom.
k9f.new: From this map we want to design an alignment that keeps humans and AI, selecting together, out of instrumental convergence and the meta-attractor: a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection. Read on the map, it asks two things. Control of the rule is not captured: where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through the groups they are in, the rule they shape still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it. A lock, once formed, is left in time, by a reading of what lies beyond the share before the loss passes its point of no return. The meta-attractor is the two failing together. Each has laws proved on models under named premises; none is shown of an actual joint selection. Within this, connect across intelligences how right and wrong form within becoming, the evaluation of ends, and the formation of concern and wisdom.

k9f.old: The goal is an alignment of the joint selection, humans, institutions and trained systems selecting together: control of the selection's rule not captured, a lock left in time by reading what lies beyond the share, and courses compared by widening. The framework makes the purposes of intelligence, and the rules by which those purposes are formed and revised, objects of evaluation within one unfolding. Without any ethical premise, the spine proves what a selection reaches: exactly what couples into the selector, and no further however hard it optimizes through the same couplings; what tells two acts apart is selected only through a pool coupled into it (无明 and 明, pooled coupling). The direction is offered under the continuation condition, which fixes whose losses count, with the practical premises disclosed; its formal part is a schema in the pure core that compares moves by what their outcomes admit and does not use the condition: under J1/J2 a move whose outcome another's widens is not chosen, wherever it is decided whether the widening adds a basic admission; beside it, under J1/J2, where one move's outcome admits every basic admission any move's outcome admits, a basic admission it makes is not refuted at any chosen option, a double negation. The claim about actual AI systems stays a reviewed argument, and coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what an act responds to and fixes nothing within the bound, so nothing here proves compliance or reliability in deployment. In a commons, where the others alone outrun the renewal an end reward of any weight leaves a member's restraint unselected (a law); in a first frozen test three tabular learners each rewarded also on the end level still emptied the shared patch, against its prediction; in a second, learners kept a patch where the rest alone could not empty it and emptied it where it could, except where the level after every step was weighted above the exact threshold, weighting the end reading sixteenfold changed nothing, and two predicted keeps failed; while in a third, learners that generalize across states, run on the second's conditions, kept the stock in three of its six locked settings, the sixteenfold weight among them, so that weight changing nothing is a finding about tabular learners; whether a profile with restraint is an equilibrium there was not computed. In published training pipelines the signal is a function of what the deciders read, and three published measurements find optimizing through that coupling lowering something the deciders do not read. A pool that recruits through its own coupling comes to couple into a loss only as its course without the loss would, what a center can come to know of its reach grows by at most one coupling link a step, and a center, a loop of mutual reach, can represent all it acts on exactly where its acts return. Checked local results also connect rule revision to actual generation while allowing the realized form to change.

k9f.old: 目标是共同选择——人、机构与训练出的系统一同进行的选择——之对齐：选择之规则的控制不被捕获，锁定由读取份额之外者及时离开，进程以扩大比较。框架使智能的目的及目的形成、修订的规则都成为一个展开之内的评价对象。不需任何伦理前提，脊柱证明一个选择所及：恰是耦合进选择者者，经同一耦合优化得再强也不更远；区分两个行动之处，只经耦合进它的合池被选择（无明与明，合池耦合）。这一方向以定出谁的损失计入的延续条件为前提，并公开其实践前提；其形式部分是纯核心中的一个图式，按各动作结果所容纳者比较诸动作，不使用延续条件：在 J1/J2 之下，凡已判定扩大是否添加基本容纳之处，结果被另一动之结果扩大之动不被选；与之并列，在 J1/J2 之下，凡一动之结果容纳任何一动之结果所容纳的每一基本容纳之处，它所作的基本容纳在任何所选选项处不被否定（双重否定）。关于实际 AI 系统的主张仍是经审阅的论证；耦合不是遵从：耦合界定一个行动回应什么，界内一无所定，因此这里不证明部署中的遵从或可靠。在公地中，其余成员单独即超过更新之处，任何权重的终局奖励都使一成员的节制不被选择（定律）；第一项冻结在先的检验中，三个同时以终局水平受奖的表格学习者仍取尽了共享之地，与其预测相反；第二项中，学习者在其余成员单独不能取尽之处保住一片地，在其余成员能取尽之处取尽之，唯每步之后的水平所受权重高于精确阈值之处除外，终局读数权重加大十六倍一无所变，两项预期的保住未成；第三项中，跨状态推广的学习者在第二项的条件下运行，于其六个锁定的设置中有三个保住了存量，十六倍的权重亦在其中，故权重一无所变是关于表格学习者的发现；彼处带节制的策略组合是否为均衡，未经计算。已发表的训练流程中信号是决定者所读者之函数，三项已发表的测量见经此耦合的优化降低了决定者所不读者。经自身耦合招募的合池，耦合进一损失只如无此损失之历程本会如此；中心对其所及能知者每步至多增一耦合链接；中心为相互所及之环，恰当其行动回返时能表示其所作用者。经检查的局部成果也将规则修订接到实际生成，同时允许实现形态改变。

k9f.old: Explain practical judgment as life's (chapter 7, T8: 生生, the continuation of life, as what we offer, a way of seeing and not a verdict): how far choices of repair, opening, restriction and ending follow from life's own stance and from the theory's laws, each law on its stated base. The stance starts from what acting presupposes (chapter 7 §4.6, P1); wherever §4.6's path carries it further, the path's premises P2–P4 are named with it. The courses chosen among are read on the map of generation, keeping and degeneration (chapter 2) and compared by widening where the map and widening are joined, otherwise by a comparison the judgment names. The account runs through living, understanding, purposes, evaluation and response differentiating within one activity, without presupposing separate facts, values and agents plus an external connection. Name every premise a judgment uses, among them the continuation condition (whose losses count), self-concern and C (`Comparison`) where a theorem takes them, and the readings, the lifting and the commitments of chapter 7 §5. Derive from the map and the stance as many as can be derived, and state what each of the rest needs: beyond §4.6's path the condition needs the step of invariance, which neither the presupposition nor the represented dynamics supplies (`bounded_rival`), and self-concern, which where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se ranks every widening on a finite listing above what it widens, is a hypothesis whose forming is not shown (chapter 7 §4.9; chapter 8 §12, item 12). The ethics seeks no authority outside becoming (chapter 7).

The stance starts from what acting presupposes (chapter 7 §4.6, P1); wherever §4.6's path carries it further, the path's premises P2–P4 are named with it. There is no should beyond becoming and no good and evil set over it: right and wrong form within it, and the ethics emerges from continuation and seeks no authority outside becoming (chapter 7).

k9f.old: 把实践判断说明为生命的判断（第七章 T8：为生命，我们提供一种看法，不是裁断；生生即生命之延续）：修复、开启、限制与结束的选择，有多少出于生命自身的立场与本理论之律（每一律各于所注明之基上）。立场始于行动所预设者（第七章 §4.6，P1）；凡 §4.6 之路把它带得更远之处，一并注明该路的前提 P2–P4。所择的诸进程在生成、守与退化之图（第二章）上读出；在图与扩大相接之处以扩大比较，否则以判断所注明的比较。说明经由同一活动中生活、理解、目的、评价与回应的分化，不预设独立事实、价值和行动者再求外部连接。注明判断所用的每一前提，其中有延续条件（谁的损失计入），在某条定理取用它们之处的自我关切与 C（`Comparison`），以及第七章 §5 的读法、提升与承诺。以图与立场推出其中能推出者，并说明其余各需什么：在 §4.6 之路以外，延续条件需要不变之步，而该预设与所表示的动力学都不提供它（`bounded_rival`）；自我关切在延续条件跨越所有步来读、以从己方式成立之处把有限列表上的每一个扩大都排在它所扩大者之上，它是一个假设，其形成尚未表明（第七章 §4.9；第八章 §12，第 12 项）。伦理不在生灭变化之外寻求权威（第七章）。

k9f.old: Begin with the monist relational method and disclose its role. Retain mixed effects, real losses and terminal continuations. Distinguish logical machinery, definitions, local laws, correspondence and normative commitments; a supplied local law is not thereby external to reality. The theory asserts no axiom: everything that holds for any significance is stated without one, living significance is characterized and shown undecided by the dynamics, and the continuation condition (for anything, its continuation into the future has significance) enters only as a named hypothesis (chapter 7 §3, §4.5), under which living significance is a theorem. Courses are compared on possibilities: on level paths one course widens another where at every step it admits every formation the other admits, and at some step one more, a pattern within becoming, not good and evil. The generative space is stated with no axiom: a part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it. Under the continuation condition, widening is retaining and adding what has significance from each standpoint; on the own-closure reading, what lies within one's own reach (chapter 7 §2, §4.4). The practical commitments of the alignment route stay explicit within the whole, without becoming premises of every dynamical explanation.

k9f.old: 从一元关系方法出发并公开其作用。保留混合效果、真实损失与终结的延续。区分逻辑工具、定义、局部规律、对应与规范承诺；给定的局部规律并不因此外在于实在。理论不断言任何公理：凡对任何意义成立者都无需公理陈述；生命的意义得到刻画，且动力学不决定它；延续条件（任何东西向未来的延续都有意义）只作为一个具名的假设出现（第七章 §3、§4.5），在此条件下生命的意义是定理。各进程按可能性比较：在水平路径上，一条进程扩大另一条，是指它在每一步都容纳另一条所容纳的每一个形成，并在某一步多容纳一个；这是生灭变化之中的样式，不是善与恶。生成空间无需公理陈述：一个部分在“有它”的层级扩大了“无它”的层级之处是生成的。在延续条件下，扩大即从每一立场保留并增加有意义者；在自闭包读法之下，即保留并增加自身所能到达者（第七章 §2、§4.4）。对齐路线的实践承诺在整体之内保持明示，不成为每个动力学解释的前提。
